title: Decomposition of an affine linear remainder
statement: Let $a_0\in\mathbb{R}$, let $a\in\mathbb{R}^n$, let $i,j$ be distinct coordinates, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The affine linear remainder obtained by omitting coordinate $j$ equals the remainder obtained by omitting both $i$ and $j$, plus the term $a_ix_i$.
